report_info.subject: Comparison of Original vs. Enhanced Architectures

main_architecture_comparison.description: Comparison of the full Neuro-Symbolic Hybrid System (MLP + Rules + Fuzzy + Bayes)

updated_code_optimizer_benchmarks.description: MLP Baseline performance in the Updated Code across different optimizers (Fast Run, 20k samples)

technical_conclusions: The Updated Code effectively corrects the majority-class bias observed in the original baseline.
Isolation Forest (ISO) combined with the new oversampling strategy yields higher sensitivity.
The Hybrid layer provides stable safety metrics (Recall > 83%) across all tested optimizers.
The Enhanced architecture is significantly better for medical diagnostic robustness.
